items.briefing:
Australian edtech platform Mathspace has disclosed a data breach affecting over one million people, which is directly relevant to anyone whose students or staff may have used the service. If your organisation uses Mathspace, check whether your learners' data may be involved and watch for follow-up communication from the company. Separately, scammers are increasingly impersonating high-profile celebrities like MrBeast to trick people — a reminder that social media giveaways or prize offers from famous names are almost always scams.

**Practical tip:** If you receive a message about the Mathspace breach, go directly to Mathspace's official website for updates rather than clicking links in emails.
